_note: Android Gradle Plugin + Gradle that scripts/patch-build-gradle.mjs forces onto the generated android/ project for the RELEASE build (rule R5 in ANDROID-BUILD-RULES.md). Play Console asks for AGP 9.0+. To change any of these, edit it here — nothing else — and let the R8 smoke test in android-release.yml prove the build still runs. AGP 9.0 needs Gradle 9.1.0 or newer. googleServices is the Firebase build plugin (lock-screen notifications); Capacitor's template pins 4.4.4, which predates AGP 9. crashlytics (Gradle plugin) and crashlyticsSdk are the crash-report pair that scripts/setup-crashlytics.mjs adds only to a build that has Firebase's config (rule R6); bump them together.
